newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Lloyds Bank A1 plus ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Lloyds Bank A1 plus ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it affirmed its A1 plus commercial paper, CD, and short-term counterparty rating of Lloyds Bank Plc.

The action came following the announcement that Lloyds TSB Group Plc -- the parent of Lloyds Bank Plc -- was making an offer to acquire the 37.6 percent of Lloyds Abbey Life Plc that it did not already own, S&P said in a statement.
"The financing of the deal is made up of a mix of equity and cash, with the minimum cash outlay being 790 million sterling and the maximum, 1,220 millionstg," the statement said.

"While this represents a substantial purchase for the group, very strong earnings during 1996 should ensure that the impact on capital ratios will be only minimal when the deal is scheduled to become effective at the end of 1996."

As a result of the acquisition, management expect to achieve cost savings of about 50 million per annum within three years through the full integration of the combined businesses in Lloyds Abbey Life and Lloyds TSB, S&P said.
